limits: Cursor events count actual SQLAlchemy DBAPI execution dispatches, not parameter rows or coroutine resumptions
SQL elapsed is client-observed span including driver/network/server/scheduling; not pure DB CPU/lock wait
Only synchronous no-await plan property has thread CPU; dag_plan wall is inclusive across awaits and is not per-request CPU
No SQL text/parameters/request body/header/querystring/payload/DSN/token is retained
Uninstrumented control has no route/cursor/property wrapper; overhead is part of diagnostic treatment
Request context covers ASGI request lifetime; startup/background/late work is separate outside_request
No cross-request topology cache, plan reuse or optimization is installed
